example.py: wǒ xué le yí ge xīn chéngyǔ。
example.en: I learned a new idiom.

example.zh: 他不会吹竽，只是滥竽充数。
example.py: tā bù huì chuī yú，zhǐshì lànyúchōngshù。
example.en: He can't play the yu — he's just making up the numbers.
example.ru: Играть он не умеет — просто занимает чужое место.

example.py: tā ná zhe diàoyú gān qù hé biān。
example.en: He went to the river with a fishing rod.
example.ru: Он пошёл к реке с удочкой.

example.py: nǐ huì yǎnzòu shénme yuèqì？
example.en: What instrument can you play?
example.ru: На каком инструменте ты умеешь играть?

example.py: fēng bǎ màozi chuī zǒu le。
example.en: The wind blew the hat away.

example.py: guówáng hěn xǐhuan tīng hézòu。
example.en: The king loved listening to ensemble music.

example.py: xuéxiào chénglì le yī zhī yuèduì。
example.en: The school formed a band.

example.py: sānbǎi rén yīqǐ hézòu。
example.en: Three hundred people played together in ensemble.

example.py: dàjiā yīqí gǔzhǎng。
example.en: Everyone applauded together.

example.py: tā tīng gùshi tīng de rùmí le。
example.en: He was spellbound by the story.

example.py: Tā jiù xǐhuan chuīniú.
example.en: He just loves to brag.

example.py: wǒ méiyǒu rènhé wèntí。
example.en: I don't have any questions.

example.py: xiànzài chà wǔ fēn bā diǎn。
example.en: It is five minutes to eight now.

example.py: tā zhuān jiāo háizi huàhuà。
example.en: He specializes in teaching children to draw.
example.ru: Он занимается именно обучением детей рисованию.

example.py: wǒ bǎ qiánbāo diū le。
example.en: I lost my wallet.

example.py: Wǒmen yào jiějué gēnběn wèntí.
example.en: We need to solve the fundamental problem.

example.py: Tā shì wǒmen de fù jīnglǐ.
example.en: He is our deputy manager.

example.py: tā hùn zài rénqún li pǎo le。
example.en: He slipped away into the crowd.
example.ru: Он затерялся в толпе и убежал.

example.py: wǒ jiā de huā sǐ le。
example.en: The flowers at my home died.

example.py: tā de érzi qī suì le。
example.en: His son is seven years old.

example.py: lún dào tā dúzòu shí，tā pǎo le。
example.en: When it was his turn to play solo, he ran away.
example.ru: Когда пришла его очередь играть соло, он сбежал.

example.py: zhè shēngyīn xià le wǒ yí tiào。
example.en: That sound gave me a fright.

example.py: Tā qiāoqiāo liū chū le jiàoshì.
example.en: He quietly slipped out of the classroom.
